full:
You'll need it one day.

Signalizer remembers the last place your phone had cell signal — and when the signal drops, it points you back to that last-signal point with a compass arrow and the exact distance. An offline GPS compass that works with no internet and no network: in the desert, in the mountains, off-grid, anywhere with no signal.

100% offline. No internet. No account. No subscription. Total privacy — nothing ever leaves your phone.

LOST SIGNAL? GET BACK TO THE LAST SIGNAL
• While you have signal, Signalizer quietly saves your GPS location — offline, no internet.
• Tap "Heading out" before you head into the desert or off-grid. It watches your signal in the background and records your GPS trail, even if you close the app.
• No signal? A big compass arrow and the distance guide you back to the last point with network — where you can call emergency services and get help.
• Tap "I'm back" when the network is back.

AN EMERGENCY COMPASS FOR THE DESERT, OFF-GRID AND THE OPEN ROAD
• Compass, bearing and distance from GPS only — offline, no network, no internet.
• For desert trips, hiking, overlanding, camping, mountains and remote off-grid roads with no signal.
• Day mode readable in harsh desert sun, night mode for OLED screens, switching automatically at sunrise and sunset — computed from GPS, offline.
• The local emergency number for where you are, from GPS — offline, no internet.
• A short offline emergency guide: what to do when you're stranded off-grid with no signal, saving water and battery, distress signals for an emergency.
• Your GPS trail drawn on screen offline, so you can walk back the way you came to your last signal.
• Open the last-signal point in any maps app you have.

NO INTERNET, 100% — TOTAL PRIVACY
Signalizer has no internet permission at all, so it cannot send anything — real privacy, not promises. Location and trail are stored only on your device and deleted when you uninstall. No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no account. Your privacy in the desert, off-grid or in the city stays yours — offline.

WHY SIGNALIZER?
The first thing you lose off-grid is signal, and the first thing you need in an emergency is network. Signalizer is the emergency compass that brings you back to your last cell signal — an offline GPS compass, simple, private, and ready before you need it.

The emergency compass for everyone who heads into the desert or off-grid. One-time purchase. No subscription. No internet. Available in 46 languages.

FAQ
• Does it really work with no internet? Yes, 100% offline — there is no internet permission at all, and GPS works with no network.
• Does the compass need a network? No, the compass and distance come from GPS and the phone's sensors only.
• What happens in an emergency? Follow the emergency compass to your last signal — the trail drawn on screen takes you back the same way you came — then call emergency services as soon as the network is back.
• Privacy? Total privacy — offline, no account, no internet, and no data ever leaves your phone.
• Battery? GPS runs in the background only while "Heading out" is on, and the offline night mode saves battery.
